title: causal_automata
description: List of causal_automata objects. Package: https://pypi.org/project/causal-automata/

items.title: causal-automata
items.description: JAX-accelerated cellular automaton causal discovery (causal-automata). Parameters map to CausalAutomaton.fit / causal_automata.run. null death/birth/skeleton thresholds enable Fisher-z calibration from n_samples.

id.description: Algorithm identifier used in benchmark_setup evaluation ids.

ticks.description: Number of synchronous CA ticks (static for XLA).

k.description: Conditioning-set size for death/birth partial correlations. null uses the package default_conditioning_k(n).

threshold_death.description: Partial-correlation threshold for edge death. null = Fisher-z from n_samples and alpha.

threshold_birth.description: Partial-correlation threshold for edge birth. null = 1.2 * calibrated death threshold.

skeleton_threshold.description: Absolute correlation threshold for the initial undirected skeleton. null = package default (aligned with calibrated Fisher-z birth threshold via CausalAutomaton.fit).

alpha.description: Two-sided significance level for Fisher-z threshold calibration when death/birth are null (default 0.01).

fuzzy.description: Keep continuous edge weights during ticks; binarize only at the end.
